HARDWARE INSTRUMENTATION

Engineered for Ultimate Workstation Clarity

Taskee dispenses with generic bubbly consumer widgets. Instead, it provides razor-sharp borders, calibrated CPU engines, and zero-compromise hardware metrics.

⚡

Calibrated CPU Engine

Prevents the classic 0% cold-start deltas on Windows and Linux by priming measurement windows, guaranteeing instantaneous and accurate CPU percentage calculation on launch.

sysinfo 0.39 Zero Delta Lag
📈

Dual 60s Live Time Plots

Hardware-accelerated live time-series charts powered by egui_plot. Track continuous 60-second hardware load deltas with zero dropped frames.

egui_plot 60 FPS
🎛️

Per-Core Thread Matrix

Adaptive multi-core grid that dynamically displays every logical thread on your CPU. Immediate visual feedback on thread pinning and uneven workload distribution.

1 to 128 Cores Dynamic Grid
🛡️

Workstation Process Manager

Dense telemetry table featuring PID, Status (RUN/SLEEP), CPU%, RAM consumption, and live runtime. Sort instantly by any metric and terminate rogue tasks with feedback.

Instant Sort Safe Kill
💾

Storage & Network Telemetry

Monitor every filesystem mount point (/, /mnt/d, C:\, D:\) and live network interface throughput rates (KB/s RX and TX) in real-time.

All Partitions RX/TX Rates
🎨

ArtCraft Ultra-Dark Palette

Brutalist HUD aesthetic engineered specifically for developer multi-monitor setups and OLED displays. Monospace telemetry, crisp dividers, and zero distraction.

#0D0E10 Canvas OLED Optimized
BENCHMARK MATRIX

Taskee vs Traditional System Monitors

Electron monitors consume more resources than the tasks you are trying to observe. Taskee is 100% native Rust.

Telemetry Metric TASKEE (PURE RUST) ELECTRON MONITORS DEFAULT OS TASK MANAGERS
Memory Footprint (Idle) ~12 - 15 MB 350 - 650 MB 60 - 140 MB
Idle Background CPU 0.0% 1.5% - 4.2% 0.3% - 1.0%
GUI Framework & Runtime Pure Rust (eframe / egui) Chromium + Node.js + V8 Win32 / Cocoa / GTK
Live Historical 60s Plots Dual egui_plot Graphs Canvas / WebGL / SVG Basic OS graphs
Cold Start Startup Time < 150 ms 1,800 - 3,500 ms ~400 ms
Cross-Platform Consistency Identical UI (Win / Linux) Webview differences Completely different OS UIs
